name: Specsavers student discount
summary: 25% off one pair of glasses in store for students, from the $149 range up.
key: 25% off one pair of glasses from the $149 range or above, in store.
who: Students with a current student card.
how: Show your student card when you buy.
catches: One pair only. Excludes safety eyewear. Can't be combined with other offers. Lenses beyond single vision cost extra.

evidence.quote: 25% off 1 pair of glasses from the $149 range or above. If you are a student, select one pair of glasses from the $149 range or above and you are entitled to receive 25% off the total price.
